entities.summary: Tyler Lawrence France is an American professional baseball first baseman for the San Diego Padres of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Seattle Mariners, Cincinnati Reds, Minnesota Twins, and Toronto Blue Jays. France was an All-Star in 2022.
